page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The CPU configuration allocates one thread per core and includes a 33 MB L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is consistently average, placing in the middle 50% across stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate average read and write speeds for large blocks, though the overall PassMark memory score is weak.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge offers a standard general-purpose hardware profile. It delivers average throughput for static web serving, Redis SET operations, and database operations. The instance is also capable of average-tier performance for medium-sized LLM inference tasks. Given the weak single-core metrics, this instance is best utilized for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage all 32 dedicated cores, such as parallel software compilation, web serving, and general-purpose database hosting, rather than single-threaded processing tasks.
